Hardware-testing and engineering startup Nominal raises $240M at $3B valuation. Artificial intelligence-powered hardware-testing and engineering software startup Nominal Inc. today announced it has raised $240 million in new funding led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Insight Partners. The investment triples the company’s valuation to $3 billion, up from $1 billion cemented in March after it raised $80 million in a Series B-2 funding round. Additional major investors […]
